verdict.rationale: There is direct, live confirmation of an llms.txt at the docs root plus per-subproject llms.txt files (react, web-components, supersplat, splat-transform), and a runtime probe confirms an actual llms-full.txt with complete docs (2MB+), showing strong first-party agent-oriented documentation support.
